newsitem.title: USA: Amerigon in violation of loan covenant.
newsitem.headline: Amerigon in violation of loan covenant.

text.p: Amerigon Inc said on Thursday it was in violation of certain financial and other covenants of its loan agreement and has requested a waiver or forbearance from its bank.
It also said it has requested an extension of the loan term from October 31 to November 30, and is seeking additional financing through bank borrowings, debt or equity financing, or other means.
Even if financing is obtained, the company believes it will be unable to obtain sufficient capital to pursue the development and manufacture of its products, Amerigon said.

As a result, the company plans to concentrate on the development of car seat and radar technologies and to seek strategic or financing partners for its electric vehicle and audio navigation system technologies, it said.
Amerigon makes high-tech products for the commercial automotive and electric vehicle markets.
It said it expects development contract revenues to decline significantly in the next two fiscal quarters as activity on its major electric vehicle diminishes.

Amerigon has a contract to supply electric vehicle parts to an Asian company. That contract is due to conclude at the end of the year and no replacement contract is presently scheduled to follow, it said.
